papers.title: DynThinker: Unifying Static 3D and Dynamic 4D Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract: Achieving general spatial intelligence requires a unified understanding of both static 3D and dynamic 4D. However, we find that existing models struggle to excel at both: 3D post-training can weaken dynamic understanding, while 4D-specialized models often lack strong static 3D reasoning. Our analysis reveals that this spatial--dynamic interference is highly non-uniform across parameter groups, with the balance between static and dynamic capabilities particularly sensitive to changes in late-layer MLPs. To address this interference, we propose DynThinker, a unified framework for jointly strengthening static and dynamic spatial reasoning. Decoupled Exponential Moving Average (D-EMA) applies configurable group-wise averaging to constrain drift in interference-sensitive pretrained parameters while preserving flexibility for capability enhancement. Spatial-Dynamic Fusion (SDF) complements D-EMA by selectively integrating spatial and temporal priors from a dynamic geometry encoder into intermediate VLM representations under semantic guidance. Across ten metrics spanning nine static 3D and dynamic 4D benchmarks, DynThinker achieves the highest average score among all evaluated models. Notably, DynThinker achieves 56.0 on ReVSI, 67.2 on DSR-Bench, and 51.2 and 40.1 under the sample-wise and group-wise evaluation protocols of DSI-Bench, respectively, setting new state-of-the-art results among the compared open-source models across all four evaluations within a unified model.

ai_summary.problem: 现有模型难以同时擅长静态3D与动态4D空间推理：3D后训练可能削弱动态理解，而4D专用模型往往缺乏强静态3D推理能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出DynThinker统一框架。方法包括D-EMA，对干扰敏感的参数组做可配置分组指数滑动平均以约束漂移；以及SDF，在语义引导下将动态几何编码器中的空间与时间先验选择性融合进VLM中间表示。
ai_summary.result: 在覆盖静态3D与动态4D的九个基准、十个指标上取得最高平均分；ReVSI 56.0、DSR-Bench 67.2、DSI-Bench sample-wise 51.2与group-wise 40.1，均在统一模型下刷新开源模型SOTA。
ai_summary.novelty: 发现空间-动态干扰在参数组间高度非均匀，并据此提出解耦EMA与空间-动态融合机制来统一增强静态3D和动态4D推理。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动多模态大模型/VLM向统一静态3D与动态4D空间智能发展，对具身智能、世界模型和空间推理Agent有重要意义。

papers.title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
papers.abstract: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态代码智能要求模型生成图表、网页、动画等可执行且视觉正确的产物，但开放模型受限于数据数量与质量，且缺乏同时覆盖程序正确性、构建质量和渲染视觉正确性的统一评价信号。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PrismaForge 分层数据流水线，合成可分解的 rubric，将代码正确性、构建质量和视觉正确性拆解为可检查标准，并同时用作数据过滤器和强化学习奖励。基于该流水线构建 PrismaCoder-2M 数据集，训练并开源 PrismaCoder-9B 与 PrismaCoder-35B。
ai_summary.result: 构建了目前最多样且最大的开放多模态代码智能数据集，开源的 PrismaCoder-9B/35B 大幅领先开源 SOTA，并可媲美领先闭源系统；分析表明基于 rubric 的流水线能跨模型骨干提升多模态编码性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 用分解式 rubric 同时作为数据筛选器和强化学习奖励，统一评价程序正确性、构建质量与视觉正确性，从而推动开放多模态代码智能。
ai_summary.relevance: 为开放多模态代码智能提供了大规模数据、训练方法和开源模型，有助于缩小与闭源系统差距并推动可复现研究。

papers.title: Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning with Human Interventions for Precise Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon precise manipulation produces mixed-quality data for post-training vision-language-action (VLA) models: even successful demonstrations and intervention-assisted rollouts may contain detours, hesitations, failed attempts, and imperfect recoveries. The key challenge is to identify which action chunks actually advance the task, rather than uniformly cloning or discarding imperfect trajectories. We propose Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning (GR-BC), an offline iterative post-training framework that builds a task-conditioned goal-reachability graph over demonstrations and iteratively collected rollouts, including both successful and failed episodes with human interventions. Reverse graph search computes minimal remaining steps to task success within the dataset support, and each action chunk is weighted by how much its execution reduces this potential. This consequence-based weighting reuses recoverable segments from failed trajectories, leverages interventions as recovery paths, and down-weights locally regressive chunks even inside successful trajectories. New rollouts are incorporated by appending them to the graph and rerunning search, without training a reward model, action-conditioned critic, or progress predictor. Across four precise manipulation tasks and three VLA backbones, GR-BC improves single-round supervised fine-tuning and reaches 91% success after a few offline iterations, without trajectory comparisons or progress labels. More details and videos are available at: https://gr-bc.github.io

ai_summary.problem: 长时程精细操作中用于VLA后训练的数据质量混杂，成功演示和人类干预轨迹中常含绕路、犹豫、失败尝试与不完美恢复，核心难点是识别哪些动作块真正推进任务，而非统一克隆或丢弃不完美轨迹。
ai_summary.method: 提出Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning (GR-BC)，一种离线迭代后训练框架。它在演示与迭代采集的rollout（含成功、失败和人类干预）上构建任务条件的目标可达图，通过反向图搜索计算到任务成功的最小剩余步数，并依据动作块执行后减少的“剩余步数势能”进行加权。新rollout只需追加到图并重跑搜索，无需奖励模型、动作条件critic或进度预测器。
ai_summary.result: 在四个精细操作任务和三个VLA主干上，GR-BC改进了单轮监督微调，并在少量离线迭代后达到91%成功率，且不需要轨迹比较或进度标签。
ai_summary.novelty: 利用任务条件目标可达图的反向搜索构造基于后果的动作块重加权，从失败和干预轨迹中复用可恢复片段并降权局部倒退片段，无需额外奖励或进度模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLA/机器人操作的后训练提供了一种无需显式奖励或进度标注的数据重加权方法，可提升混合质量数据与人类干预数据的利用效率。

papers.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
papers.abstract: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.

ai_summary.problem: 上下文能提升大语言模型性能，但移除上下文后这些增益可能消失。论文要解决的是如何将上下文带来的增益内化到模型参数中，同时保留非目标能力。
ai_summary.method: 论文将记忆巩固形式化为统一目标，连接上下文指定的知识编辑、技能学习和行为引导。提出 Cortex，通过生成前瞻性查询预测上下文的可能用途，并将上下文条件输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩或结构化前馈网络更新；同时构建五类任务测试台评估单次、批量和顺序更新下的巩固与保持。
ai_summary.result: 在 4B--120B 稠密和 MoE、纯文本及多模态骨干模型上，Cortex 在多数设置中位于巩固--保持的帕累托前沿。14B 模型经过 50 次顺序事实编辑后，Cortex-Structural 恢复 88.9% 的上下文诱导增益，同时保留 99.8% 的原始非目标性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出将上下文内化为可合并参数更新（低秩或结构化 FFN）的通用记忆巩固框架，并配套单次、批量、顺序更新的多任务评测基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 LLM 持续学习、知识编辑和上下文能力持久化提供了新路径，有望减少对长上下文或检索的依赖并缓解灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: Can Learning to Answer Spatial Questions Improve Novel-View Generation?
papers.abstract: Generating novel views from limited observations requires preserving both the appearance and spatial structure of a scene. Although recent approaches exploit fine-grained geometric cues, they do not explicitly model high-level semantic and spatial properties such as object identity, attributes, and inter-object relationships. In this work, we investigate whether 3D language understanding can provide complementary supervision for novel-view generation. We introduce Ask4NV, built on a pretrained unified multimodal model with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our model incorporates camera geometry into both VAE and ViT representations and leverages understanding features during generation through joint self-attention with a modality-aware attention masking strategy. Experiments demonstrate strong image quality and geometric consistency in novel-view generation, alongside competitive 3D language understanding. Further analysis shows that joint training improves cross-view correspondence in VAE representations and similarity in a 3D-aware feature space.

ai_summary.problem: 从有限观测生成新视角需要在保持外观的同时维持场景空间结构，但现有方法未显式建模物体身份、属性和物体间关系等高层语义与空间属性。本文探究3D语言理解能否为新视角生成提供互补监督。
ai_summary.method: 提出Ask4NV，基于预训练的统一多模态模型和Mixture-of-Transformers架构。模型将相机几何融入VAE和ViT表示，并通过联合自注意力与模态感知注意力掩码，在生成过程中利用理解特征。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明该方法在新视角生成中具有较强图像质量和几何一致性，同时保持有竞争力的3D语言理解能力；联合训练还提升了VAE表示的跨视角对应性和3D感知特征空间中的相似性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将3D空间问答与新颖视角生成统一在MoT架构中联合训练，并利用理解特征作为生成任务的互补监督。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明3D语言理解与视觉生成可相互促进，对统一空间多模态模型、世界模型和具身智能有参考意义。

papers.title: SafeDriveVLA: Navigation-Conditioned World Model Dreaming for Conflict-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are gaining attention in autonomous driving, inheriting commonsense priors from large language models (LLMs) and widening the navigation interface from a fixed command set to free-form natural-language instructions. However, this open-ended interface exposes a new vulnerability surface: an inattentive driver may issue instructions that are unsafe given the current scene, and a malicious user may issue dangerous ones on purpose. We present the first benchmark suite that evaluates navigation following and conflict awareness together, along with adversarial robustness. Existing VLAs fall short on both: SimLingo completes no language-instructed lane change in closed loop, and all models degrade sharply under conflicting signals. We propose SafeDriveVLA, the first driving VLA that (1) explicitly predicts a three-level navigation-compliance mode to decouple conflict reasoning from action generation, and (2) uses navigation-conditioned world model dreaming to inform this prediction. Unlike prior world models that roll out expert or planned actions, ours dreams of strictly following the navigation signal, showing when following is safe. SafeDriveVLA reaches 88.16 Driving Score (DS) and 68.64% Success Rate (SR) on Bench2Drive, lifts closed-loop language following by 49.3% and reduces collisions under unsafe instructions from 60 to 38 compared to the best SimLingo variant. Video demonstrations are available on our project page.

ai_summary.problem: 现有端到端自动驾驶VLA模型在开放自然语言导航接口下，面对不安全或恶意冲突指令时缺乏安全性与鲁棒性，且缺少同时评估导航跟随、冲突感知和对抗鲁棒性的基准。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出首个联合评估导航跟随、冲突感知与对抗鲁棒性的基准套件，并提出SafeDriveVLA：显式预测三级导航遵从模式，将冲突推理与动作生成解耦，并利用导航条件世界模型“ dreaming”来推断何时跟随导航信号是安全的。
ai_summary.result: SafeDriveVLA在Bench2Drive上达到88.16 Driving Score和68.64% Success Rate，闭环语言跟随能力比最佳SimLingo变体提升49.3%，并将不安全指令下的碰撞数从60降至38。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将导航跟随、冲突感知与对抗鲁棒性统一评测，并首次在驾驶VLA中引入显式导航遵从模式与导航条件世界模型 dreaming 来提升冲突场景安全性。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动语言条件端到端自动驾驶向更安全、更鲁棒的VLA/Agent方向发展，对开放指令下的具身智能安全具有参考意义。

papers.title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
papers.abstract: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric. Layout Thinker Optimization (LTO) aligns the rewriter with both caption and rendered-image quality via alternating domain-specific policy optimization. SKU-DiT, trained under Reinforce-Distill-Reinforce (RDR) progressive training, conditions jointly on the white-background product image, the trademark crop, and the structured layout to hold subject fidelity, trademark integrity, and character-level text accuracy together. The framework runs in production at a scale of millions of main images per day with a latency of a few seconds per image, which we believe makes it among the first systems of this kind to operate at commercial scale. We also release CommerceGen-Bench, a benchmark of hard cases collected from live traffic across all product categories. On it, our framework achieves the highest overall scores among the evaluated open-source baselines on both editing tracks, with and without prompt enhancement. It also matches much larger closed-source models, and beats several of them at Instruction Following and Product Integration - the two properties that determine whether an image can be published.

ai_summary.problem: 电商SKU主图生成需要同时保证商品主体保真、商标完整、文字准确、卖点表达和排版合理，现有方法难以在商业规模下端到端满足这些约束。
ai_summary.method: 提出 CommerceGen-Studio 三阶段框架：PERL-Agent 用 VLM/LLM 闭环从SKU元数据提取卖点；LTO 通过交替领域策略优化对齐改写与图像质量；SKU-DiT 在RDR渐进训练下联合以白底产品图、商标裁剪和结构化布局为条件生成主图。
ai_summary.result: 框架每天可生成百万级主图、单图延迟数秒；在 CommerceGen-Bench 上取得开源基线最高总分，匹配更大闭源模型，并在 Instruction Following 和 Product Integration 上超过部分闭源模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 将卖点提取、语义改写、布局优化和多条件扩散生成统一为可商业规模部署的端到端主图生成框架，并发布来自真实流量的难例基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了可控多模态生成在电商内容生产中的工业级落地路径，对多条件图像生成、Agent闭环优化和商业AIGC系统有参考意义。

papers.title: GeoThinker-$F$: Endogenous Predictive World Representations for Fast Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.

ai_summary.problem: 现有几何感知的多模态大模型（MLLM）依赖外部3D编码器提供结构先验，导致推理时额外的延迟和计算开销。
ai_summary.method: 提出 GeoThinker-$F$，将 MLLM 的因果隐状态转化为可预测的潜在世界表征，从而内化时空感知。采用解耦的两阶段训练：第一阶段冻结 MLLM 主干，用轻量级 Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) 头从离线3D几何专家和下一帧语义目标中学习；第二阶段移除外部专家，通过 Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion 模块联合优化自预测先验的生成与选择性融合。
ai_summary.result: 在无需运行时依赖外部3D几何编码器的前提下，在多个空间智能基准上保持有竞争力的性能，推理最高加速 $3.6\times$，延迟从 $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ 降至 $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$。
ai_summary.novelty: 用 MLLM 自身隐状态预测出的潜在世界表征来替代外部3D编码器先验，实现端到端内生的几何与未来语义预测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的高效空间智能与内生世界模型提供了新范式，对具身智能和实时空间推理有直接价值。

papers.title: PhySGA: A Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for Generalizable and Interactive 3D Composition
papers.abstract: 3D object composition is pivotal to digital content creation and robot simulation, while also serving as a critical testbed for physical intelligence in foundation models. Previous methods either leverage large language models to directly predict object coordinates, or utilize generative diffusion priors to synthesize composite images for visual alignment, both of which rely on static priors in digital spaces. However, these methods consistently struggle with complex compositions such as precise hanging, gravity-driven settling and hidden containment, as these tasks require interactive construction processes involving global planning, fine-grained alignment, and physical simulation. To address these challenges, we propose PhySGA, a Physics-Space Grounded Agentic Framework for 3D composition via agent exploration and physical simulation, enabling the universal interactive assembly of rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Directly applying vanilla LLMs or VLMs to this task proves insufficient, as current models inherently lack grounded physical understanding and interactive construction experience. To overcome this limitation, we design a collaborative feedforward-feedback architecture: an Assembly Agent focuses on geometric and kinematic reasoning for global step planning and coarse adjustment, while a Critic Agent reasons over contact dynamics for simulator state diagnosis and fine-grained closed-loop correction. Furthermore, Action Routers map semantic planning and analysis onto executable physical primitives within the simulator, while a task-specific Self-Evolving Skill Library distills historical trial-and-error feedback into reusable experiences, boosting success rates and minimizing exploration attempts. Extensive experiments within Isaac Sim demonstrate that PhySGA significantly surpasses existing methods in relation fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.

ai_summary.problem: 现有3D物体组合方法依赖数字空间中的静态先验，难以处理悬挂、重力沉降、隐藏容纳等需要交互构建和物理仿真的复杂组合任务。
ai_summary.method: 提出PhySGA，一个在物理空间中基于智能体探索与物理仿真的3D组合框架。其包含协作式前馈-反馈架构：Assembly Agent负责几何与运动学推理和全局规划，Critic Agent基于接触动力学进行状态诊断与闭环微调，并通过Action Routers映射物理原语、Self-Evolving Skill Library积累可复用经验。
ai_summary.result: 在Isaac Sim中的大量实验表明，PhySGA在关系保真度、物理合理性和视觉质量上显著优于现有方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 将LLM/VLM智能体与物理仿真闭环结合，并引入自进化技能库，实现可泛化、可交互的刚体/铰接体/可变形体3D组合。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动了具身智能、世界模型和基础模型在物理空间中进行交互式构建与真实物理理解的研究。

papers.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
papers.abstract: Character Error Rate (CER), the standard metric for OCR and vision-language models (VLMs), charges a typo as much as a wrong name. We introduce semCER, which keeps CER's alignment and denominator and charges each grapheme edit a severity from an LLM judge, with no word segmentation. Normalized CER keeps the score of a whole transcription, where it tracks readers as well as semCER or better, and semCER breaks that score down into named edits. The charges track readers' ratings edit by edit in English, Vietnamese, and Chinese and put the edits readers rate most severe near the top of a sorted list. On pairs drawn where CER and semCER disagreed, readers side with semCER more often than with normalized CER in English and Chinese, and equally often in Vietnamese. Across 16 languages, the judge charges a wrong diacritic or tone mark almost nothing in Spanish but nearly a wrong letter's severity in Telugu. Where we can count real words, a general VLM's wrong letter forms one far above chance while a classical pipeline's stays near it. We release the 61 million judged edits, the aggregated reader ratings, and the distilled scorer at https://github.com/nguyenx2t/semcer.

ai_summary.problem: OCR和视觉语言模型常用的CER指标把所有字符错误同等对待，导致一个拼写小错和关键人名错误得分相同，无法反映错误的实际严重程度。
ai_summary.method: 提出semCER，在保留CER对齐方式和分母的前提下，用LLM judge为每个字素编辑赋予严重性权重，且无需分词；同时保留归一化CER作为整体转录评分，并可将semCER分解为带名称的编辑项。
ai_summary.result: semCER的严重性评分在英语、越南语和中文中逐编辑项追踪读者评分，并能将读者认为最严重的编辑排在前面；在CER与semCER不一致的样本上，英语和中文读者更常支持semCER，越南语中两者持平。跨16种语言显示严重性判断差异，且通用VLM的错误字母显著高于随机水平，而经典流水线接近随机。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将LLM judge引入CER框架，实现保留原始对齐与分母、可分解且语言无关的严重性加权字符错误率。
ai_summary.relevance: 为OCR和VLM提供更贴近人类感知严重性的评估指标，有助于更公平地比较模型错误类型与实际危害。

papers.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
papers.abstract: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

ai_summary.problem: 当前 agentic robots 领域发展迅速但研究较为分散，缺乏统一视角来理解如何将不同 agentic 功能整合为完整的机器人系统。
ai_summary.method: 该论文对现有研究进行统一综述：先梳理从机器人策略到 agentic 系统的发展，涵盖视觉-语言-动作模型、世界模型和世界-动作模型；随后界定 agentic robots 的定义与范围，并按 Model、Data、Environment、Harness 四大功能域、十七个类别组织文献。
ai_summary.result: 论文提供了一个统一的分类与综述框架，说明 agent 如何影响模型学习与机器人决策、采集与整理机器人数据、构建学习与评估所需的世界/任务/测试，以及组织机器人能力使用，并讨论了开放挑战与未来方向。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统性提出面向 agentic robots 的跨模型、数据、环境与执行框架四大维度的统一分类与综述框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于连接分散的具身智能与机器人 Agent 研究，为构建更强大、可靠和自适应的机器人系统提供路线图。

papers.title: Look Before You Restore: Learning to Predict Before Acting for Agentic Image Restoration
papers.abstract: Agents for mixed-degradation image restoration typically learn what a tool does to an image only after running it: failed calls waste computation and harmful outputs go unnoticed until too late. We propose PreActIR, an agentic restoration framework that predicts tool consequences before execution. For each candidate tool, a tool-conditioned world model forecasts changes in residual degradation, image quality, and fidelity, together with the risk of harm and the uncertainty of the prediction. The agent executes the top-ranked candidate, and an independent verifier commits or rolls back its output before the agent replans from the observed state. PreActIR also audits whether performance is limited by the selector or by the candidate space, and studies targeted tool adaptation as a controlled way to expand that space. In a controlled evaluation that fixes the candidate pool, verifier, and budget and employs reference-annotated degradation states, PreActIR uses 42.5% fewer real tool calls and 63.4% fewer rejected calls than reactive, execute-then-evaluate trial and error, while improving Y-PSNR by 0.92 dB.

ai_summary.problem: 混合退化图像恢复的智能体通常需要先执行工具才知道其效果，导致失败调用浪费计算，且有害输出不能及时被发现。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PreActIR，在工具执行前用工具条件世界模型预测残余退化、图像质量、保真度变化，以及危害风险和预测不确定性；选择最优候选执行后，由独立验证器决定提交或回滚，智能体再从观测状态重规划。
ai_summary.result: 在固定候选池、验证器和预算的受控评测中，PreActIR 相比反应式“先执行再评估”试错，真实工具调用减少 42.5%，被拒调用减少 63.4%，Y-PSNR 提升 0.92 dB。
ai_summary.novelty: 将工具条件世界模型引入智能体图像恢复，实现“先预测后果、再执行与验证回滚”的闭环决策。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了预测式世界模型在工具型智能体中的效率与可靠性价值，对多模态智能体和具身智能体具有借鉴意义。

papers.title: ReferFlow: Beyond Final-Target Localization for Complex Referring Expressions
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models have made significant progress in referring expression comprehension (REC), yet most REC benchmarks still focus on final-target localization. Complex queries often involve intermediate visual references with different dependencies on prior grounding, but final-only evaluation leaves this process unexamined. To address this gap, we formulate trajectory-level REC, in which models receive an ordered sequence of grounding steps constructed from a single complex query and localize the target regions associated with each step. We instantiate this setting in ReferFlow-Bench, which characterizes structured region transitions through four trajectory types, namely Refinement, Shift, Reset, and Mixture. Experiments show that current models struggle to consistently ground intermediate visual references across successive steps. We further propose ReferFlow, which decouples interleaved text-latent trajectory generation from coordinate decoding. Specifically, Stateful Region Latent Reasoning represents each target region as an object-indexed state composed of continuous latents, with explicit visual and spatial supervision to preserve region information for subsequent grounding. Trajectory-Aware Parallel Decoding then recovers all coordinate blocks in parallel through four geometry-constrained refinement rounds, with each block conditioned on its corresponding trajectory prefix, thereby reducing within-box sequential dependencies and eliminating cross-box autoregression. We further apply Grounding-Aware GRPO to promote consistent grounding across steps and learn adaptive trajectory generation from complex REC queries. ReferFlow achieves leading performance on general REC benchmarks and ReferFlow-Bench.

ai_summary.problem: 现有指代表达理解（REC）评测多只关注最终目标定位，忽略了复杂查询中具有依赖关系的中间视觉引用，导致模型多步定位过程未被检验。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出轨迹级REC设定及ReferFlow-Bench，用Refinement、Shift、Reset、Mixture四类轨迹刻画结构化区域转移；并提出ReferFlow，将文本-潜变量轨迹生成与坐标解码解耦，采用状态化区域潜推理、轨迹感知并行解码和Grounding-Aware GRPO提升多步一致定位。
ai_summary.result: 实验显示当前模型难以稳定定位连续步骤中的中间视觉引用，而ReferFlow在通用REC基准和ReferFlow-Bench上均取得领先性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 将REC从最终目标定位推进到轨迹级多步视觉引用定位，并设计解耦式潜状态推理与并行坐标解码框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于推动多模态大模型在复杂指代、多步视觉推理和可解释定位能力上的评测与方法发展。

papers.title: Human Demonstrations as Post-Training Data for Any Robot Body: Retargeting the Object, Not the Hand
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations are today used largely for pretraining vision-language-action models, with little ability to use the same data for target-embodiment or task-oriented training, which scalable deployment of robots in industrial and general environments depends on. A human demonstration recorded on a simple and scalable device such as a mobile phone can serve as post-training data for a robot whose body differs in structure and capability from the human who recorded it. This is made possible not by retargeting the hand's motion but the object's. A capture yields a body-free record: the object's pose over time, its contact intervals, and a reconstructed 3D object with provenance. Any robot, given as a URDF and a short descriptor, is solved against that record and scored in simulation against the demonstrated object motion as ground truth: the human-to-simulation leg of human-to-simulation-to-robot transfer, measured per robot. Each (robot, episode) pair gets one outcome: pass, failure with a named mode, or refusal, with its reason, before any motion. The method runs as a working system over a growing collection; the set analysed here is a sample of it: 42 captures solved on 8 robots, 157 pairs, of which 31.2% pass, 52.2% fail, 14.0% are refused and 2.5% are unauditable (kinematic feasibility, +/-50 mm / +/-15 deg, in simulation). Refusals held up: every pair the checks refuse on stored evidence yet ran anyway failed (13 of 13; 5 on a body whose public model welds its hand). A description file could not be shown to screen a robot: its outcomes were barely more predictable than guessing. No policy has yet been trained on the record. The record decides what a robot may post-train on; whether the policy then works on the real robot is the simulation-to-robot question, answered downstream.

ai_summary.problem: 人类演示目前多用于预训练视觉-语言-动作模型，难以作为目标机器人身体或任务导向的后训练数据，限制了机器人在工业和通用环境中的可扩展部署。
ai_summary.method: 论文不重定向手部运动，而是重定向物体：从手机等简单设备捕获无身体记录，包括物体随时间位姿、接触区间和重建的3D物体；给定机器人URDF和简短描述后，在仿真中求解该记录，并以演示的物体运动为真值进行评分。每个（机器人，片段）对得到一个结果：通过、带失败模式的失败或在运动前的拒绝及原因。
ai_summary.result: 系统在42个捕获、8个机器人、157个配对样本上运行：31.2%通过，52.2%失败，14.0%被拒绝，2.5%不可审计。拒绝结果可靠：所有在存储证据上被拒绝却仍运行的配对均失败（13/13）；但描述文件无法有效筛选机器人，结果接近随机猜测。尚未在该记录上训练任何策略。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是以物体为中心而非手部动作进行重定向，使人类演示可作为任意机器人身体的后训练数据并进行仿真可行性评估。
ai_summary.relevance: 为跨具身机器人学习、VLA后训练和可扩展机器人部署提供了一种数据筛选与仿真验证框架。

papers.title: Read, Parse, Describe: Unified Document Parsing with Visual Element Description Generation
papers.abstract: Document understanding systems are typically evaluated as separate components via layout analysis, optical text recognition, reading-order prediction, and image captioning. This separation leaves scientific figures, captions, and visual semantics weakly connected, and fails to measure whether a model can produce a single page-level parse that is both structurally faithful and semantically accessible. We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a unified dataset for document parsing with visual element description generation. Given a page image, models are required to output an ordered list of layout elements containing bounding boxes, semantic labels, reading-order indices, recognized textual content, and alternative text descriptions for visual elements. The benchmark is built from 2,402 documents, comprising 18,163 continuous pages, 125,218 layout elements, and 11,338 visual instances. Besides, we further propose a plug-and-play space-awareness enhancer that reuses multi-layer visual features and injects grid-aware spatial guidance into vision-language tokens for layout-aware generation. Experiments across end-to-end VLMs and pipeline parsers show that existing systems still struggle to jointly recover reading order and visual semantics, while our enhanced model achieves strong joint performance. These results highlight the need to move beyond isolated document parsing modules toward unified models that jointly read, parse, and describe complex documents. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yufanchen96/RPD

ai_summary.problem: 现有文档理解系统通常将版面分析、光学文字识别、阅读顺序预测和图像描述分开评估，导致科学图表、题注和视觉语义关联薄弱，也无法衡量模型能否生成结构忠实且语义可访问的页面级统一解析结果。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出统一数据集 Read-Parse-Describe（RPD），要求模型对页面图像输出包含边界框、语义标签、阅读顺序索引、识别文本以及视觉元素替代文本描述的有序版面元素列表；同时提出即插即用的空间感知增强器，复用多层视觉特征并向视觉-语言 token 注入网格感知空间引导，以支持布局感知生成。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明，现有端到端 VLM 和流水线解析器仍难以同时恢复阅读顺序与视觉语义，而所提增强模型在联合任务上取得较强性能，说明文档解析需要从孤立模块走向统一模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向“读取-解析-描述”统一文档解析任务的大规模基准数据集，并提出可增强视觉-语言模型布局感知能力的空间感知增强模块。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动文档理解从分离模块评估转向统一页面级解析与视觉语义生成，为多模态大模型在复杂文档场景中的结构化理解提供新基准和方法。

papers.title: STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents
papers.abstract: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents have achieved promising performance in interacting with real-world interfaces through screenshot-based grounding. However, high-resolution screenshots and multi-turn histories introduce excessive visual tokens, causing substantial inference overhead. Existing token pruning methods, mainly designed for natural images, often select tokens independently based on importance scores, which can fragment the local visual structures required for recognizing small GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and hyperlinks. In this work, we propose STP-GUI (Spatially-aware Token Pruning for GUI agents), a query-guided token pruning framework that preserves fine-grained instruction-conditioned token scoring while performing spatially coherent window-level selection under aggressive token reduction. A lightweight selector is optimized through policy learning while the VLM backbone remains frozen. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets. At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on Android in the Wild further suggest that the method transfers to mobile GUI environments.

ai_summary.problem: Web-GUI 智能体使用高分辨率截图和多轮历史时会产生大量视觉 token，导致推理开销巨大；现有 token 剪枝方法多面向自然图像，独立选 token 会破坏识别按钮、图标、超链接等小型 GUI 元素所需的局部视觉结构。
ai_summary.method: 提出 STP-GUI，一种查询引导的空间感知 token 剪枝框架：保留细粒度、由指令条件驱动的 token 打分，同时在激进 token 压缩下进行空间连贯的窗口级选择。通过策略学习优化轻量选择器，并保持 VLM 主干冻结。
ai_summary.result: 在 Online-Mind2Web 上，21% token 保留率下仍保持全 token 性能的 77.7%，推理延迟降低 31%，FLOPs 降低 57%；在 Android in the Wild 上的结果进一步表明方法可迁移到移动 GUI 环境。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是针对 GUI 元素识别需求，将 token 剪枝从独立 token 选择改为查询引导且空间连贯的窗口级选择。
ai_summary.relevance: 该方法提升了 VLM 驱动 GUI 智能体的推理效率，有助于推动高分辨率界面理解智能体的实际部署。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Sentiment Prediction Under Local Modality Missingness
papers.abstract: Multimodal sentiment models are usually evaluated on complete utterances, yet streams often lose a contiguous span of text, audio, or video. We study local missingness on aligned CMU-MOSEI features. Our reliability-aware network (RM-Net) keeps the original temporal positions, represents unobserved positions with a learned token, outputs bounded per-modality intensity contributions gated by observation quality, and is trained with dual-view masking of contiguous segments. We fuse five RM-Net seeds with a LoRA-adapted BERT text expert, using a fusion weight that depends only on the visible fraction of content tokens. Architecture, checkpoint, and fusion choices were made on the validation split. On the held-out split, the fused model reaches a macro-F1 of 0.655 on clean inputs and 0.634 under 40\% mixed missingness; its two-view average exceeds the auxiliary-head baseline by 0.024 (95\% video-cluster bootstrap interval [0.003, 0.045]). Because this split was inspected during development, these numbers are not a blind test. For explanations, exact Shapley attributions over the eight modality subsets and position-level occlusion show that top-ranked positions reduce the predicted-class probability faster than random positions (AUC gap 0.113 on validation). We also describe an auditable word-level alignment pipeline for raw clips; its outputs do not feed the predictive models.

papers.title: ActiveEvidence: Decision-Focused Evidence Graphs with Verifiable Acquisition Gaps
papers.abstract: A multimodal agent must decide whether visual evidence is worth acquiring, which candidate or resolution to query, and when further interaction can no longer change its decision. We study this problem under a strict free-metadata/paid-observation boundary, stochastic vector costs, and a frozen execution trace, and treat it as decision-certifiable active evidence acquisition. A Counterfactual Evidence Interaction Graph (CEIG) represents unary evidence value, signed second-order interaction, and directed conditional harm while maintaining explicit score enclosures for unresolved interactions; a decision-weighted enclosure objective tightens the bounds that can change action identity. Gap-directed refinement evaluates only interactions that can displace the incumbent acquisition and stops once an $ε$-decision certificate shows that unresolved terms cannot change the selected action beyond a declared tolerance. The certificate is model-relative: it verifies policy-consistent optimality under the pinned learned score, and semantic quality is measured separately through post-freeze labels. Paired continuation rollouts learn the downstream value of paid previews, an online operational cost filter is separated from independent finite-policy-family trajectory certification, and an acquisition monitor with an independently implemented verifier binds every certificate to the frozen trace. On 640 cases split into 384/128/128 training, validation, and test cases, the controller reaches task score 0.842, grounding F1 0.816, evidence recall 0.873, 1.74 accepted calls, 286.5K visual tokens, and 742ms p95 latency. Dense replay of issued certificates shows 0.992 action agreement and a 0.988 certificate rate while evaluating 19.6 instead of 191.4 expensive interaction terms per decision.

papers.title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.

papers.title: Cascaded Retrieval with Cross-Modal Query Refinement for Efficient Visual Document Search
papers.abstract: Retrieving information from visually rich documents requires matching queries against pages that contain complex evidence in tables, figures, and layout-dependent structures. Current vision-language retrievers address this but incur query-time costs that grow with corpus size and are impractical to scale. We propose SCOUT, a cascaded two-track retrieval framework that separates retrieval performance from exhaustive search. The visual track first uses a lightweight parent retriever to filter the corpus to a compact candidate pool, then applies a stronger multi-vector reranker only to those candidates. In parallel, a semantic track retrieves over hierarchical page and document summaries generated offline to provide a signal complementary to visual matching. The outputs are fused through cross-modal query refinement, which uses semantic scores to adjust the visual query representation before final ranking. We evaluate SCOUT on 4 major benchmarks against 6 baselines and observe a significant query-time latency improvement up to 80.7x (28.8x on average) relative to the best baseline, while exceeding state-of-the-art retrieval performance by up to 7.8% NDCG across all benchmarks.
